**0.7.0 is a breaking release.** It changes the Raft WAL format (format epoch 3) and removes the memory WAL, so the per-core disk journal is the only Raft WAL. 0.7 cannot read 0.6 data: a node refuses 0.6 Raft WAL directories and object-storage prefixes at startup, `ursulactl restore` refuses 0.6 backups, and a node will not join a cluster with 0.6 nodes. There is no in-place upgrade, no automatic migration and no rollback.

- **If you run 0.6 with data you need to keep, stay on 0.6.2.** 0.7 provides no migration path from 0.6.
- **Deploy 0.7 fresh:** empty PVCs and a never-used object-storage prefix. With cold storage off and S3 snapshots, also use a new snapshot prefix, and with the event-time indexer a new or emptied indexer prefix.
- **The memory WAL is gone.** Every node of a multi-node cluster needs `raft.wal.path`. Remove `raft.wal.backend`, `raft.wal.allow_volatile_multi_peer`, `raft.memory_bootstrap_marker_dir` and `raft.rejoin_probe` from config files, and `raft.storageMode`, `raft.allowVolatileMultiPeer` and `persistence.enabled` from Helm values: they now fail validation.
- **`raft.wal.fsync` now defaults to `never`.** A write is acknowledged once a quorum of voters holds it in the page cache. If a majority of a group's voters crash at once, writes acknowledged after their last `fsync` can be lost and the group waits for an operator. The 0.6 disk WAL fsynced every batch: set `always` (Helm `raft.walFsync`) to keep that.
- **Recovery gate.** A replica that may have lost acknowledged writes neither votes nor campaigns until it has applied a fresh barrier from its group's leader, which rebuilds it. A group with a majority of its voters gated stops until an operator runs `POST /__ursula/raft/{group}/recovery/accept-unsynced-loss`.
- **Removed:** the `ursulactl` verbs `prepare-restart`, `restart-quiesce-capability`, `finish-prepared-restart`, `abort-prepared-restart`, `prepare-amnesiac-restart`, `repair-restarted-voter`, `prepare-recovery-handoff` and `classify-amnesiac`, and the admin endpoints `quiesce-for-restart`, `rejoin/adopt-survivor` and `rejoin/reinitialize`. A planned restart is `drain`, restart, `wait` and `undrain`.
- **Admin mutations need `x-ursula-process-incarnation`.** Custom tooling must send the `process_incarnation` from `/__ursula/metrics`.
- **Readiness checks the node's own Raft replicas.** `/__ursula/ready` answers `503` with `raft_replica_unready` while a local replica is not a healthy voter. Healthy survivors stay ready while a wiped replica rebuilds, so alert on `incomplete_voter_set` in `/__ursula/metrics` for lost redundancy. `ursulactl wait-ready` still waits for full redundancy.
- **`helm upgrade` from 0.6 stops before a second voter is replaced.** Recover with `helm rollback`. A 0.7 node that contacts 0.6 peers makes them answer `503` with `format_epoch_mismatch` on `/__ursula/ready` until they restart.

Known issues: [#411](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/411) and [#454](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/454). Every change is listed in the [0.7.0 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#070), and installing 0.7.0 is described in [Upgrading to 0.7](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/operations#upgrading-to-07).
